items.lede: South Korea's Financial Services Commission (FSC) held an emergency meeting following a series of cyberattacks targeting financial institutions in the country. [...]
items.title: South Korea probes bank breaches amid suspected AI-powered attacks

items.lede: South Korean president Lee Jae Myung told his cabinet that there were signs that hackers used AI to execute the attacks on the banks.
items.title: Hackers suspected of using AI agents for cyberattacks on South Korean banks, exposing data from about 25,000 customers
